maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly tolling and violation management for rental fleets plus camera enforcement programs, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Larger Commercial & Fleet segment bills rental car and fleet companies for tolls and violations; government camera programs are the smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from tolling, violation and camera programs; acquisitions like Redflex and HTA were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Integrated tolling and violation systems embedded in rental fleets, plus regulated enforcement cameras for municipalities, are costly and disruptive to replace.
